name: 64834 · Carl Junction, MO
findings: ZIP 64834 (Carl Junction) has 28 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 64834 (Carl Junction) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
44% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 64834 (Carl Junction) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 46% of the typical level).
